scope: su/main/synthetics_waveforms_testpatterns part 2 of 2 — incomplete: only surandspike and suspike have been fully inventoried; the other 11 programs still require source and library-call review.

programs.name: surandspike
programs.purpose: Generate SU traces containing randomly placed spikes.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SURANDSPIKE - make a small data set of RANDom SPIKEs

params.name: mode
params.description: Use different spikes on each trace when 1, or repeat the first trace when 2.

params.name: n2
params.description: Number of traces; the selfdoc incorrectly states 200.

params.name: nspk
params.description: Number of spike placements per generated trace.

params.name: amax
params.description: Absolute amplitude limit; negative values are negated.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The random generator and float rounding determine spike indices and amplitudes. A placement can address sample n1, beyond the samples written in the trace. Repeated placements overwrite earlier amplitudes.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program generates random indices and amplitudes and writes traces.

test_cases.description: Generate independently randomized traces with a fixed seed.
test_cases.command: surandspike n1=128 n2=8 dt=0.004 nspk=5 amax=0.5 mode=1 seed=123

test_cases.description: Repeat the same random spike pattern on each trace.
test_cases.command: surandspike n1=64 n2=4 dt=0.002 nspk=8 amax=0.3 mode=2 seed=7

programs.name: suspike
programs.purpose: Generate a common-offset SU dataset with up to four unit spikes.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSPIKE - make a small spike data set

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset stored in each trace header.

params.name: nspk
params.description: Number of enabled spikes; the first spike is always enabled.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Spike sample indices are not validated; invalid values can write outside the intended trace data. Header conversion truncates floating-point values.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program fills trace headers and sets individual samples.

test_cases.command: suspike nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.002 offset=100 nspk=2 ix1=3 it1=20 ix2=12 it2=80

test_cases.description: Generate all four spikes with custom positions.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=64 ntr=8 nspk=4 ix1=1 it1=5 ix2=2 it2=15 ix3=5 it3=30 ix4=8 it4=60
